series.name: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)
series.notes: Smallest single-phase residential line. This manual numbers codes as 'ID01'..'ID98' (two digits, no leading zero) - the codes are transcribed exactly as printed. Several are IDs unique to this table and do NOT exist on KTLX/ME/HYD: ID05 PVUVP, ID57-ID59, ID71, ID83/ID84, ID89, ID93, ID97, ID98. Manual also states for this series: 'If an Earth Fault Alarm occurs, the fault will be displayed on the LCD screen, the red light will be on' - hence the blinkPattern on the insulation rows.

meaning.en: Grid voltage is above the inverter's over-voltage window. This line prints the code as 'ID01' without a leading zero.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki over-voltage window se upar hai. Is line par code 'ID01' likha hai, leading zero ke baghair.

causes.en: Grid voltage excursion or a badly set transformer tap on the local feed.
causes.ur: Grid voltage excursion ya local feed par transformer ka tap ghalat set hua.

causes.en: AC breaker not fully engaged, or high-resistance AC wiring causing a drop then a spike.
causes.ur: AC breaker poora engage nahi hua, ya high-resistance AC wiring.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter at the AC terminal and note the value and time.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter se grid voltage measure karke value aur time note karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC circuit breaker and AC wiring as the manual directs for this code.
solutions.ur: Is code ke liye manual ke mutabiq AC circuit breaker aur AC wiring check karein.

solutions.en: If grid readings are within range but the alarm repeats, ask support to adjust protection points with DISCO approval.
solutions.ur: Agar grid reading range mein hai phir bhi alarm repeat ho to DISCO approval ke saath support se protection points adjust karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

meaning.en: Grid voltage has dropped below the under-voltage window and the inverter disconnects.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage under-voltage window se neeche gir gaya hai aur inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Long low-voltage feeder with a heavy evening load - voltage sags badly at dusk.
causes.ur: Lambi low-voltage feeder par shaam ka heavy load - shaam ko voltage bohat gir jata hai.

causes.en: AC connection loose at the breaker or at the inverter input.
causes.ur: Breaker ya inverter input par AC connection loose.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage at the inverter while the evening load is running; check the sag depth.
solutions.ur: Shaam ka load chal raha ho tab AC terminal par voltage measure karein; girawat kitni hai dekhein.

solutions.en: Power off and re-torque the AC input terminal, checking for heat marks or a blackened lug.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC input terminal dobara tighten karein aur garmi ke nishaan ya kala lug dekhein.

solutions.en: If voltage is also low at the main distribution board, report a low-voltage complaint rather than touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar main distribution board par bhi voltage kam ho to inverter chhoone ke bajaye low-voltage complaint report karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

meaning.en: The PV string Vmp is below the inverter's minimum operating voltage. Manual fix: add series modules. This code is also the reference used by other rows - e.g. ID25 says 'If the PV array configuration is correct (no ID05 fault)'.
meaning.ur: PV string ka Vmp inverter ki minimum operating voltage se neeche hai. Manual ka hal: series mein modules barhayein. Yeh code doosri rows ka reference bhi hai - maslan ID25 mein likha hai 'agar PV array configuration sahi hai (ID05 fault nahi)'.

causes.en: Too few modules in series for the string voltage to reach the MPPT window.
causes.ur: String voltage ko MPPT window tak pohanch karne ke liye series mein modules kam hain.

causes.en: Very low irradiance at start-up - haze, heavy cloud, or early morning.
causes.ur: Start-up par bohat kam irradiance - dhund, heavy cloud, ya subah ka waqt.

solutions.en: Measure the string Voc and Vmp with a multimeter on a clear midday and compare to the datasheet MPPT range.
solutions.ur: Saaf dopahar par multimeter se string ka Voc aur Vmp measure karke datasheet MPPT range se compare karein.

solutions.en: If Voc is within range, this is just low sun - the inverter restarts automatically as irradiance returns.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc range mein hai to ye sirf kam dhoop hai - irradiance wapas aate hi inverter khud restart ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is genuinely low, add series modules or add a second string on a model that supports it.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc asal mein kam hai to series mein modules barhayein ya model mutabiq doosri string lagayein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

meaning.en: String Voc is above the inverter's maximum input voltage - too many modules in series. Manual fix: reduce series modules.
meaning.ur: String ka Voc inverter ke maximum input voltage se upar hai - series mein modules zyada hain. Manual ka hal: series modules kam karein.

causes.en: String designed on a cold-temperature Voc that exceeds the inverter max in this climate.
causes.ur: String thande temperature ka Voc le kar design hui jo is climate mein inverter max se cross kar jati hai.

causes.en: Modules swapped for a higher-Voc type without redoing the string calculation.
causes.ur: Modules badal kar higher-Voc wale lagaye gaye, string calculation dobara kiye baghair.

solutions.en: Measure string Voc with a multimeter on the clearest, coldest morning available.
solutions.ur: Sab se saaf aur thande subah mein multimeter se string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate the string using the module's Voc temperature coefficient at the site minimum temperature, then reduce series count.
solutions.ur: Site ki minimum temperature par module ka Voc temperature coefficient use kar ke string dobara calculate karein, phir series count kam karein.

solutions.en: Do not simply energise to 'see if it works' - overvoltage damages the input stage.
solutions.ur: Sirf 'chalta hai ya nahi' dekhne ke liye current na dein - overvoltage input stage ko nuksan deta hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

meaning.en: The input mode (parallel/independent) setting does not match how the array is wired. Manual fix: change input mode per section 6.3(A) 10.
meaning.ur: Input mode (parallel/independent) setting array ke wiring se match nahi karti. Manual ka hal: section 6.3(A) 10 ke mutabiq input mode badlein.

causes.en: Installer selected independent mode but both MPPTs are fed, or the reverse.
causes.ur: Installer ne independent mode set kiya magar dono MPPT feed hain, ya ulta.

causes.en: Settings reset to default after a firmware update.
causes.ur: Firmware update ke baad settings default par reset ho gayi.

solutions.en: Count how many PV strings are physically connected to each MPPT port first.
solutions.ur: Pehle gino ke har MPPT port par kitni PV strings physically lagi hain.

solutions.en: Set input mode from the LCD menu to match: parallel when both inputs have strings, independent when only one does.
solutions.ur: LCD menu se input mode set karein: dono input par strings hon to parallel, sirf ek par hon to independent.

solutions.en: Re-check the input mode after every firmware update so the setting does not silently revert.
solutions.ur: Har firmware update ke baad input mode dobara check karein taake setting khud se wapas na ho jaye.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

title.ur: GFCI leakage fault - residual current device trip hua (ID12)

meaning.en: Residual current device tripped. If it happens occasionally the manual says the external circuit was momentarily abnormal; if it is frequent, insulation is the suspect.
meaning.ur: Residual current device trip hua. Agar aam tor par aaye to manual ke mutabiq external circuit mein palay waqt ghalti thi; agar baar baar aaye to insulation shak hai.

causes.en: PV array to earth insulation too low - moisture on modules, connectors or cable.
causes.ur: PV array se earth ki insulation kam - module, connector ya cable par nam.

causes.en: Insulation condition of the PV cable degraded with UV and heat.
causes.ur: PV cable ki insulation UV aur garmi se kharab ho gayi.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch and AC breaker and wait 5 minutes before touching DC wiring.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karein, phir DC wiring chhoonein.

solutions.en: Measure insulation resistance between the PV array and earth; a low reading confirms the cause.
solutions.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation resistance measure karein; kam reading wajah confirm kar deti hai.

solutions.en: Then check the insulation condition of the PV cable and replace the damaged section or connector.
solutions.ur: Phir PV cable ki insulation condition check karke damaged hissa ya connector replace karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

title.ur: DC bus voltage unbalanced - andar ki bus voltage bigadi hui hai (ID27)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage is not balanced. The manual classes this as an internal fault requiring a DC switch off / 5 min wait / on cycle.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage balanced nahi hai. Manual isay internal fault batata hai jis ke liye DC switch off, 5 minute wait, phir on ka cycle chahiye.

causes.en: A failing DC link capacitor causing the bus halves to drift apart.
causes.ur: DC link capacitor kharab hone se bus ke do hisse alag alag ho gaye.

causes.en: Sample circuit fault on the bus voltage measurement.
causes.ur: Bus voltage measurement ka sample circuit fault.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 5 minutes, then turn it ON to see whether the fault is rectified.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ON karke dekhein ke fault theek hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check whether the fault cleared; the manual says to do exactly this check before calling support.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke fault clear hua ya nahi; support ko call karne se pehle manual yahi check kehta hai.

solutions.en: If it returns every restart, the bus voltage sensing circuit needs service - log events for the warranty claim.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par wapas aaye to bus voltage sensing circuit ko service chahiye - warranty claim ke liye events note karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

meaning.en: The relay self-test failed. Manual solution text for this block: internal faults - turn off DC switch, wait 5 minutes, turn on, then check.
meaning.ur: Relay ka self-test fail hua. Is block ka manual solution: internal faults - DC switch off karein, 5 minute wait, on karein, phir check karein.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay coil drive or detection circuit faulty on the control board.
causes.ur: Control board par relay coil drive ya detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Turn OFF the DC switch, wait 5 minutes, then turn it ON and check whether the fault is rectified.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ON karke dekhein ke fault theek hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat the relay connector and check for socket pins pushed back.
solutions.ur: Power off karke relay connector dobara baithayein aur socket ke piche pushed pins dekhein.

solutions.en: If the relay test still fails, replace the relay module via a service centre - do not keep re-powering the grid.
solutions.ur: Agar relay test phir bhi fail ho to relay module service centre se replace karwayein - grid baar baar energize na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and earth is too low, so the inverter locked out. Manual fix: rectify any short circuit.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation bohat kam hai, is liye inverter lock out ho gaya. Manual ka hal: short circuit theek karein.

causes.en: Water ingress on module backs, connectors or the junction box - typical after monsoon.
causes.ur: Module ke peeche, connectors ya junction box mein paani - monsoon ke baad aam.

causes.en: Cable abraded against a roof edge or a mounting bracket.
causes.ur: Chhat ke kinare ya mounting bracket par cable ghisat.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then check insulation resistance between the PV array and earth.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karke PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation resistance check karein.

solutions.en: If a short circuit exists, rectify the fault - identify the string by testing them one at a time.
solutions.ur: Agar short circuit hai to ghalti theek karein - strings ko ek ek karke test karke pehchan lein.

solutions.en: Replace the water-damaged part, dry and reseal the enclosure, then re-measure before energising.
solutions.ur: Paani se kharis hissa replace karein, enclosure sukhein aur seal karein, phir current dene se pehle dobara measure karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

meaning.en: The inverter core temperature is above the limit. Manual fix: make sure installation position and method meet section 3.4 requirements.
meaning.ur: Inverter core temperature limit se upar hai. Manual ka hal: installation position aur tareeqa section 3.4 ki requirements ke mutabiq honi chahiye.

causes.en: Unit mounted in direct afternoon sun on a rooftop.
causes.ur: Unit dopahar ki dhoop mein rooftop par lage hai.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked or fan obstructed, so cooling is ineffective.
causes.ur: Heat sink band ya fan blocked, jis se cooling bekaar ho gayi.

solutions.en: Compare the installation position and method against the manual's section 3.4 requirements.
solutions.ur: Installation position aur tareeqa manual ke section 3.4 requirements se compare karein.

solutions.en: Power off and clean the heat sink with an air blower; never use water or detergent.
solutions.ur: Power off karke heat sink ko air blower se saaf karein; paani ya detergent kabhi na lagayein.

solutions.en: Add shade and clearance if the unit is exposed, and re-check the LCD temperature after it cools.
solutions.ur: Unit exposed ho to shade aur clearance barhayein, aur thanda hone ke baad LCD temperature dohara check karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

title.ur: Invalid country setting - country code ghalat hai (ID97)

meaning.en: The country code stored in the inverter is not valid, so the grid protection profile cannot be applied. Manual fix: reset the country code per section 6.3(A) 4.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein store shuda country code valid nahi hai, is liye grid protection profile lagaya nahi ja sakta. Manual ka hal: section 6.3(A) 4 ke mutabiq country code set karein.

causes.en: Country code erased or left at factory default after a display board replacement.
causes.ur: Display board badalne ke baad country code mit gaya ya factory default par chhoda gaya.

causes.en: Unit imported with a country file that is not valid for the local DISCO grid.
causes.ur: Unit aise country file ke saath import hua jo local DISCO grid ke liye valid nahi.

solutions.en: Check the current country value on the LCD before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi badalne se pehle LCD par current country value check karein.

solutions.en: Reset the country code per manual section 6.3(A) 4.Set Country Code, using the DISCO-approved profile.
solutions.ur: Manual section 6.3(A) 4.Set Country Code ke mutabiq country code reset karein, DISCO approved profile use kar ke.

solutions.en: Confirm the unit resumes exporting after the reset; an invalid code blocks grid connection by design.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad confirm karein ke unit dobara export karta hai; invalid code by design grid connection rokta hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

title.ur: SD card fault - SD card nahi chal raha (ID98)

meaning.en: The inverter's SD card is not readable. Manual fix: replace the SD card. This code exists only on this small single-phase table.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka SD card readable nahi hai. Manual ka hal: SD card replace karein. Yeh code sirf is chhoti single-phase table par hai.

causes.en: SD card physically loose, bent, or not fully inserted in its slot.
causes.ur: SD card physically loose, tangi ya slot mein poora baitha hi nahi.

causes.en: Card corrupted by a power cut during a data write, or card failed after age.
causes.ur: Data write ke dauran power cut se card corrupt, ya umar ke baad card fail.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter, remove the SD card and reseat it firmly in the correct orientation.
solutions.ur: Inverter power off karke SD card nikaalein aur sahi direction mein mazbooti se dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Try a new FAT32 card; the manual's instruction is to replace it, not to reformat the faulty one.
solutions.ur: Naya FAT32 card lagayein; manual ka instruction usay replace karna hai, kharab card ko format karna nahi.

solutions.en: If the new card still faults, the card slot or reader on the board has failed.
solutions.ur: Agar naya card bhi fault de to board ka card slot ya reader fail ho gaya hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list
